title: Agreement outside an interval
statement: For natural numbers $a,n$ and integer-valued sequences $\mu,\mu'$, say that they agree outside the interval specified by $a,n$ when they agree at every index outside that interval.
caveat: The formal snippet does not define the predicate Outside, so the interval and its boundary convention cannot be determined from the supplied ground truth.
